label: Работа
description: A 10-sentence usage card for работа (work; job).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Работа' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Интересная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the judgement of the job.

missions.phrase: Я каждый день езжу на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Работу' is the accusative after 'на', showing motion toward the workplace. 'Каждый день' marks the daily routine.

missions.phrase: Сегодня я вернулся с работы поздно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of origin. 'Работы' is the genitive after 'с', showing motion away from work. 'Поздно' adds the time, and 'сегодня' fixes the day.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Работе' is the prepositional form after 'на', stating he is at work. 'Сейчас' marks the present moment.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a short adjective. 'Работой' is the instrumental required by 'доволен', meaning satisfied with. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Работу' is the accusative direct object of 'искать'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'мне нужно' frames the necessity.

missions.phrase: Без работы трудно платить за квартиру.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Работы' is the genitive after 'без', meaning without a job. 'Платить за квартиру' uses the accusative for what is paid for.

missions.phrase: Она рассказала о своей новой работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Работе' is the prepositional after 'о', expressing speech about the job. 'Своей новой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.

missions.phrase: У нас много работы на этой неделе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Работы' is the genitive singular required by 'много', here meaning a lot of work. 'На этой неделе' gives the prepositional time frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Работы' is the nominative plural here meaning tasks or jobs. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'закончить вовремя' states the requirement.
